nodes.name: Schedule: daily 06:45
nodes.notes: Every client, every day after the 06:00 sync. Workflow settings > Timezone: FF's time zone.

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: "Check website" on the client page. Answers 202 at once; the check carries on.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Set SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY after import. Pick the FF GHL OAuth credential on the GHL nodes.

nodes.name: Auth: read token
nodes.notes: Uses .first() on Webhook - singleton upstream node, so no paired-item ambiguity.

nodes.name: Auth: verify token
nodes.notes: Auth check block 2/4. Supabase Auth validates the JWT (signature, expiry). neverError + fullResponse so a 401 is data for 'Auth: check role', not a crash.

nodes.name: Auth: load profile
nodes.notes: Auth check block 3/4. Reads profiles with the service role. If the token was invalid it asks for the all-zero id, which matches nothing, and 'Auth: check role' has already got the 401 from the previous node.

nodes.name: Auth: check role
nodes.notes: Every downstream node reads the caller from $('Auth: check role').first().json.user - never from the request body. client_viewer workflows must also check user.client_id against the requested resource.

nodes.name: Respond: denied
nodes.notes: Same deny node in every webhook workflow. Returns 401/403/500 with a plain message; never echoes the token or profile.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'started', message: 'Checking. The client page updates in a minute.' }) }}

nodes.name: Fetch page
nodes.notes: Public page only, no login. One request at a time.

nodes.name: Apply findings
nodes.notes: Client type (online payment found = online cremation, unless set by hand), website and phone when empty.

nodes.name: GHL: agency
nodes.notes: FF's GHL agency id, read from a client already linked (Config GHL_COMPANY_ID is the fallback).

nodes.name: GHL: list sub-accounts
nodes.notes: FF's GHL sub-accounts (name, website, phone) to link clients by themselves.

nodes.name: Save GHL links
nodes.notes: Links a client to its GHL sub-account when the match is unambiguous.
